summary_zh: 美國擴大先進晶片出口與轉運管制，泰國等五國的先進運算產品需事先取得許可，在泰華商的高階零組件合規審查壓力上升。美泰貿易協定雖有突破，但川普稱泰國將取消美國商品關稅、泰方予以駁斥，關稅細節仍未定，出口成本難以預估。英業達子公司獲BOI批准追加投資，顯示台廠仍持續加碼泰國。
summary_en: US export controls on advanced chips now cover Thailand and four others, raising transshipment and compliance risk for Chinese-owned makers. A US-Thai trade deal advanced, but tariff details are disputed, keeping export costs unclear. Inventec's subsidiary won BOI approval for more investment.

items.summary_en: A US Interim Final Rule tightens export and transit controls on advanced chips to stop Chinese firms accessing AI via risky third countries.

items.title: 蘇帕吉：川普稱泰取消美商品100%關稅不實
items.summary_zh: 泰國商務部長駁斥川普稱泰國將取消美國商品100%關稅的說法。
items.summary_en: Thai commerce minister disputes Trump's claim that Thailand will scrap 100% tariffs on US goods.

items.title: BIS強化AI晶片管制》ODM台廠：短期影響有限
items.summary_zh: 美國BIS新規將泰國等五國納入先進運算產品許可要求，台廠ODM評估短期影響有限。
items.summary_en: US BIS rule adds Thailand and four other countries to advanced computing licence requirements; Taiwanese ODMs see limited near-term impact.

items.title: 川普：與泰國達成貿易共識 泰將取消對美關稅
items.summary_zh: 川普宣布美泰貿易共識，泰國將對美國商品取消所有關稅。
items.summary_en: Trump announces US-Thailand trade consensus; Thailand will cancel all tariffs on US goods.

items.title: 英業達追加投資泰國逾25億銖 累計破200億銖
items.summary_zh: 泰國BOI批准英業達旗下子公司追加投資逾25億銖，累計投資破200億銖。
items.summary_en: Thai BOI approves Inventec subsidiary's additional investment of over THB 2.5 billion, cumulative above THB 20 billion.

items.title: 泰国再迎汽车投资！欧洲、中国、韩国车企纷纷布局
items.summary_zh: 泰國副總理表示，目前約有6至7家車企來泰布局，包括歐洲、中國與韓國業者。
items.summary_en: Thai deputy PM says about 6–7 carmakers from Europe, China and Korea are investing in Thailand's auto sector.

items.title: 美國加強晶片管制 泰數據中心待評估
items.summary_zh: 美國擴大先進半導體出口管制，並要求第三國數據中心評估算力用途。
items.summary_en: US tightens advanced chip export controls and is pressing third-country data centers to assess compute use.

items.title: 云算力新规下，中国企业有绕道的办法吗？
items.summary_zh: 文章解讀美國雲算力新規，泰國等五國的先進芯片出口需事先取得許可。
items.summary_en: Article analyses new US cloud-compute rule requiring licences for advanced chip exports to Thailand and four other countries.

items.title: 泰美《對等貿易協定》取得突破 關稅戰未結束
items.summary_zh: 泰美簽署聯合聲明，雙方《對等貿易協定》談判取得突破，但關稅爭議尚未結束。
items.summary_en: Thailand and the US signed a joint statement on the reciprocal trade agreement, but tariff disputes are not over.
